methodology.baseline: EMA20>EMA50; close>EMA20; RSI14 50-68 rising; volume >=1.1x prior 20 average; 1.5 ATR stop; 50% at 2R, rest at 3R; trend exits.
methodology.breakout: Close above prior 20-candle high; EMA50>EMA200; volume >=1.2x prior 20 average; 2 ATR stop; exit below EMA20 or EMA50<EMA200.
methodology.regime: ADX14>=25 and EMA50>EMA200: trend breakout. ADX14<=18 and close>EMA200: RSI2<8 below lower 2SD Bollinger. Otherwise no new entry. 2 ATR stop.
methodology.execution: Signal at completed 4h close; execute at next 4h open. Stop checked intrabar; stop-first for ambiguous OHLC paths.
methodology.costs: 0.1% fee and 0.1% slippage per side. Independent $10 virtual account for each strategy.
methodology.limitations: Candle simulation cannot model order-book depth, actual spread, partial fills, outages or execution latency.
